output_format: Each row: [x1, y1, x2, y2, confidence, class_id] in 640x640 letterbox coords. Max 300 candidates.
provenance_notes: Fine-tuned from yolo26n.pt on public TI1K+Roboflow fingertips plus oversampled Braille fingertip photos and pseudo-labelled glasses-camera frames, with lighting augmentation and no-fingertip negatives (Gold Braille pages, glasses frames without a hand, tip-free crops, COCO without people). conf_threshold chosen on validation data including negatives.
flutter_notes: Preprocess: letterbox resize to 640x640, RGB, float32, divide by 255. Parse output0: filter confidence >= 0.35 and class_id == 0, take highest-confidence row; none -> no fingertip.
